== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Kotai]] clan is a major power within [[The Empire|the Empire]], recognized as one of the most frequent names among [[sacred artists]]. Members of this clan are characterized by their gray skin and have been observed utilizing massive [[stone]] elephants as emblems. Their responsibilities include maintaining a defensive wall along the [[Trackless Sea]] to protect against ocean tribes, as well as managing various duties such as executing criminals and returning runaways from the [[Stonedeep Mines]]. The clan's leadership includes an [[Underlord]], and notable individuals include [[Kotai Shou]], a former sea captain with a [[stone]]-[[madra]] [[Remnant]] limb, and [[Kotai Taien]]. The clan is considered one of the primary servants of the [[Akura clan]].}}
